title: Patient Safety Week Advisory
content:
This is to inform all employees that Patient Safety Week will be celebrated from May 27 to May 31, 2026.

Please see the schedule below and ensure full participation from all departments.

Thank you for your cooperation.

title: IT System Maintenance Notice
content:
System maintenance is scheduled for Saturday, July 5, 2026 from 12:00 AM to 4:00 AM.

Please save all work beforehand and log out of all hospital systems before midnight on Friday.

title: New Leave Policy Effective August 2026
content:
Management announces updates to the Leave Policy effective August 1, 2026.

  • Addition of Emergency Leave credits (5 days/year)
  • Revised maternity leave: 105 days
  • Revised paternity leave: 14 days

Please coordinate with HR for any questions.

title: Annual Physical Exam Schedules
content:
HR reminds all employees that Annual Physical Examinations (APE) are scheduled for the third week of July 2026.

Please coordinate with your department head for your assigned time slot. Bring your HMO card and employee ID.

content:
📢 Shared Announcement — from IT Superadmin

**RMBGH Official Mailing System and Communication Policy**

**1. Objective**
This policy defines the rules for using the Rosario Maclang Bautista General Hospital (RMBGH) electronic mail system. It ensures secure, professional, and legally compliant communication across all hospital operations.

**2. Scope**
This policy applies to all employees, medical staff, contractors, and interns using official hospital email addresses (e.g., @quezoncity.gov.ph or official RMBGH subdomains).

**3. Acceptable Use**
- Business Purpose: Use hospital email strictly for official healthcare, administrative, and operational communications.
- Professional Tone: Maintain a professional, polite, and clear tone in all messages.
- Official Signatures: Include your full name, job title, department, and contact information in all outgoing emails.

**4. Data Privacy and Confidentiality**
- Patient Privacy: Never send Patient Health Information (PHI) to external or personal email addresses.
- Encryption: Encrypt all emails containing sensitive medical records or financial details.No Auto-Forwarding: Do not set up automatic forwarding to personal email accounts (like Gmail or Yahoo).

**5. Prohibited Activities**
- Do not use hospital email for personal business, political campaigns, or commercial gain.
- Do not distribute offensive, defamatory, or discriminatory material.
- Do not share email passwords or allow unauthorized personnel to use your account.

**6. Monitoring and Compliance**
The RMBGH IT Department monitors the mail system to protect network security.
Users have no expectation of privacy for messages sent or received on hospital networks.
Violating this policy may lead to disciplinary action, including suspension or termination.
